CANDIDATES_PER_MENTION = 3
CHANGED_LABEL = 'Understood differently since this note was read (ideas this note relies on, as known on its date; read the note again in their light, and answer as before where its meaning does not change):'
CLAIMS_PER_CANDIDATE = 3
EVIDENCE_CHARS = 200
KNOWN_NAMES = 15
KNOWN_PREDICATES = 15
KNOWN_SLOTS = 30
LATER_CLAIMS_PER_CANDIDATE = 12
LATER_LABEL = "LATER (recorded after this note's date — do not restate; say if a statement is an earlier state of one of these):"
LATER_SUMMARIES_PER_CANDIDATE = 2
LINK_MENTIONS_PER_CALL = 15
OPEN_TASKS = 8
PREVIOUS_EXTRACT_LABEL = 'This note was previously understood as (its own earlier reading; a statement this text makes again keeps the same subject and the same predicate as written here):'
PREVIOUS_LABEL = 'This note was previously understood as (its own earlier reading, before what the notebook knows; a statement this note still makes is the same statement as its previous one: name it by its P number with `same_statement_as_previous`):'
SIMILAR_NOTES = 5
SUMMARY_CHARS = 240
TOPICS = 50
WITHDRAWN_LABEL = '  withdrawn by you — do not restate (you said these are wrong):'
def clip(text, limit):
    """One line of at most ``limit`` characters, cut at a word boundary (packet views only)."""
    s = ' '.join(str(text or '').split())
    if len(s) <= limit:
        return s
    cut = s[:limit].rsplit(' ', 1)[0]
    return (cut or s[:limit]).rstrip(' ,;:') + '…'
def note_envelope():
    """The user message's head ``<runtime_metadata>`` envelope: the SAME bytes for every call.

    The runtime keeps an envelope that is already at the head of a message byte for byte and
    stamps a fresh per-second one only on a message without one; a per-call timestamp there would
    end the shared prefix after a few tokens. The note's own time and id go at the END of the
    message (``note_header``), where they cannot break the cached prefix."""
    return '<runtime_metadata>{"time": "the note\'s own date is on the last line of this message"}</runtime_metadata>'
def filing_packet(note_id, occurred_at, title, text, similar, revisits, topics):
    """The dynamic half of the quick filing prompt: ``{envelope, title, text, context, header}``."""
    lines = []
    sims = []
    for s in (similar or [])[:SIMILAR_NOTES]:
        if isinstance(s, dict) and (s.get('title') or s.get('note_id')):
            sims.append('“' + clip(s.get('title') or 'untitled', 100) + '” (' + str(s.get('occurred_at') or '')[:10] + ')')
    if sims:
        lines.append('Similar earlier notes: ' + '; '.join(sims) + '.')
    days = [str(r.get('occurred_at') or '')[:10] for r in revisits or [] if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('occurred_at')]
    if days:
        lines.append('Earlier notes with the same words: ' + ', '.join(days[:5]) + '.')
    shown = [str(t) for t in topics or [] if str(t).strip()][:TOPICS]
    if shown:
        lines.append('Existing topics: ' + ', '.join(shown) + '.')
    when = str(occurred_at or '')[:16].replace('T', ' ')
    return {'envelope': note_envelope(), 'header': 'About this note (not part of its text): ' + str(note_id or '') + (', written ' + when + ' (now, for this note)' if when else '') + '.', 'title': clip(title, 200) if str(title or '').strip() else '(none)', 'text': str(text or '').rstrip(), 'context': '\n'.join(lines) if lines else 'Nothing related is saved yet.'}
return {"packet": filing_packet(note_id, occurred_at or received_at, title, text, similar, revisits, topics)}
